# GPT Image prompts: icons

<!-- Generated by tool/gen_icon_prompts.dart. Edit that file and re-run instead of editing this one. -->

Ready-to-paste prompts for the icons that replace the emoji still used in the UI: obstacle and goal icons, restaurant icons, restaurant furniture and a few dialog icons. The style matches the booster icons and the [board tiles](../tiles/README.md). To change the style or an icon, edit `tool/gen_icon_prompts.dart` and run:

```bash
dart run tool/gen_icon_prompts.dart
```

## How to use

- Model `gpt-image-1`, `size: 1024x1024`, `background: transparent`, `quality: high`, `output_format: png`.
- Every file is made of **2×2 sheets of four 512×512 cells**, read left→right, top→bottom (f1 f2 / f3 f4). Each cell becomes one icon; a sheet with fewer icons leaves the last cells empty.
- Use the **Edit** endpoint for every sheet. The first sheet of a file gets an existing game asset as the input image so the set matches the game; generate it a few times and keep the best. Every later sheet in the file gets that first sheet, so the set shares one palette and outline.
- Save sheets in `<folder>/source/` under the name the section gives, then run its **Cut** commands (ImageMagick). Each icon is trimmed to its outline, scaled to fit and centred on a square transparent canvas.
- Add new folders to `pubspec.yaml` and swap the emoji for `Image.asset` where each file's **Wiring** line says.

## Quality checklist

- [ ] Every icon reads at 24 px: shrink the cut file and check the silhouette and main colour alone tell what it is.
- [ ] Obstacle icons match their board tiles in [../tiles/board.md](../tiles/board.md) (colours, shapes).
- [ ] Restaurant icons stand out on their banner colour and keep the thin white outer rim.
- [ ] Transparent sheets have no white halo or leftover background between icons, and empty cells are really empty.
- [ ] It reads as anime chibi: flat cel shading, dark-brown outline, rounded toy-like shapes. No airbrush gradients, 3D sheen, photo texture, text or stray sparkles.
- [ ] Icons sit well next to `assets/sprites/boosters/*.png` and `assets/ui/heart.png` (outline weight, shading).
